name: Paparazzo
source:
The main character is a newspaper reporter who works in the editorial department of the "Sports Shinkansen" newspaper . He wants to receive Pulitzer Prize some day, but the reality is not so sweet. He goes to cover the idol swimming competition and hopes to get a scoop...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/08/vn-of-month-may-1996.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一名在《体育新干线》报编辑部工作的记者。他梦想有朝一日获得普利策奖，现实却并不如意。某天，他前往偶像游泳大赛采访，希望能抢到一条独家新闻……
